summary_raw: Q3 FY2026 revenue $82.9B (+18.3% YoY, beat by 2%). Azure +40%. Copilot seats 20M (up from 15M in Jan, +250% YoY). AI revenue run-rate $37B (+123% YoY). FY Q4 capex expected >$40B; full calendar 2026 capex ~$190B. Commercial bookings -46% on constant-currency due to lower OpenAI commitments. MSFT down ~15.7% YTD.
